notes: Exact HEDD Type 20 (unsuffixed/original model, not Type 20 MK2 or Type 20 A-CORE) Operation Manual, manufacturer-authored content mirrored at the cited PDF URL. It explicitly calls Type 20 an active near-/midfield three-way studio monitor and lists one 7-inch bass woofer, one 4-inch honeycomb-composite midrange, one HEDD AMT tweeter, and 3 × 300 W ICEpower amplification. The stored 900 W is the sum of those three internal amplifier ratings and is marked amplifier_output, not passive-speaker power handling. The manual lists 2-inch voice coil for the 7-inch woofer and 1.25-inch for the midrange; the scalar records only the bass woofer coil, not the midrange value. Published overall frequency range is 32 Hz–50 kHz; the separate 40 Hz–20 kHz ±1.5 dB specification is retained as context because this schema has only one pair of bounds. The manual's sensitivity is 90 dB SPL at 1 m for a 218 mVrms (-11 dBu) input with gain at 0 dB. Its actual input reference is retained verbatim in the field; it is not a 1 W/1 m or 2.83 V/1 m sensitivity and the DSP deliberately falls back to its neutral reference rather than converting or interpreting it as such. The listed 10 kΩ balanced / 47 kΩ unbalanced values are electrical INPUT impedances, not speaker load impedance, so system impedance remains N/A. The manual gives no system resonant frequency. Its on-axis free-field table separates individual woofer/midrange/tweeter responses; those component rows are not imported as a full-system response curve, and no polar/directivity dataset is published. Source: https://arispro.ru/pdf/HEDD/HEDD_Type20_Manual.pdf.
